frontier.collision_check: No open placeholder/canonicalizer PR found before patch; main advanced concurrently in unrelated WP03/UnifiedDB work, so code change isolated in a draft PR.

hypothesis: The standalone grammar-bound canonicalizer can mint a different canonical syntax identity than the production frontend because it uses Lark's default maybe_placeholders=True while production explicitly uses maybe_placeholders=False.
strongest_counterhypothesis: The placeholder default is representation-only and cannot change the canonical tree/hash for admitted ClayCode sources, so no repair is needed.

fresh_external_primary_evidence.supported_point: Lark documents maybe_placeholders=True as the default; with it, an absent [] optional produces None, while maybe_placeholders=False makes [] absence behave without a synthetic placeholder.
fresh_external_primary_evidence.late_refresh_state: A later repeat search attempt returned HTTP 503; no newer contradictory primary evidence was obtained in that subcycle.
